verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/KYC compliance platform, and a buyer could reasonably expect such a platform to offer identity-document verification, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, risk scoring, case management, transaction monitoring and exports. Nothing shows document verification sessions or extracted document fields (name, date of birth, document number, address, expiry) returned as structured data via the API.
